rules.title: Suspicious Obfuscated PowerShell Execution
rules.sigma:
title: Suspicious PowerShell Execution
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    selection:
        Image|endswith: '\powershell.exe'
        CommandLine|contains:
            - '-EncodedCommand'
            - '-Enc'
            - 'Invoke-Mimikatz'
    condition: selection
rules.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where ProcessCommandLine contains "powershell" and (ProcessCommandLine contains "-Enc" or ProcessCommandLine contains "Invoke-Mimikatz")
| project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, AccountName, ProcessCommandLine
rules.splunk:
index=windows EventCode=4688 Image="*powershell.exe" (CommandLine="*-Enc*" OR CommandLine="*Invoke-Mimikatz*")
| table _time, ComputerName, User, CommandLine
rules.sql: SELECT timestamp, host, user, command_line FROM windows_process_events WHERE process_name = 'powershell.exe' AND (command_line LIKE '%-Enc%' OR command_line LIKE '%Invoke-Mimikatz%');

rules.title: Anomalous Administrative SMB & Remote Execution
rules.sigma:
title: SMB Admin Share Lateral Movement
logsource:
    category: network_connection
    product: windows
detection:
    selection:
        DestinationPort: 445
        Image|endswith:
            - '\psexec.exe'
            - '\wmic.exe'
    condition: selection
rules.kql:
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where RemotePort == 445 and (InitiatingProcessFileName in ("psexec.exe", "wmic.exe", "cmd.exe"))
| project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, RemoteIP, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
rules.splunk:
index=windows EventCode=5140 ShareName="*ADMIN$" OR ShareName="*IPC$"
| table _time, ComputerName, SubjectUserName, SourceAddress, ShareName
rules.sql: SELECT timestamp, src_ip, dest_ip, share_name, user FROM smb_session_events WHERE share_name IN ('ADMIN$', 'IPC$', 'C$');

rules.title: High-Volume Staged Archive Exfiltration
rules.sigma:
title: Staged Archive Data Exfiltration
logsource:
    category: file_event
    product: windows
detection:
    selection:
        TargetFilename|endswith:
            - '.7z'
            - '.zip'
            - '.rar'
        TargetFilename|contains: '\AppData\Local\Temp\'
    condition: selection
rules.kql:
DeviceFileEvents
| where FolderPath contains "\\Temp\\" and (FileName endsWith ".7z" or FileName endsWith ".zip")
| join kind=inner (DeviceNetworkEvents | where TransferredBytes > 10000000) on DeviceId
| project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, FileName, RemoteIP, TransferredBytes
rules.splunk:
index=network (dest_port=443 OR dest_port=80) bytes_out>10000000
| table _time, src_ip, dest_ip, bytes_out, http_user_agent
rules.sql: SELECT timestamp, src_ip, dest_ip, bytes_sent, target_archive FROM network_exfiltration_events WHERE bytes_sent > 10000000 ORDER BY bytes_sent DESC;
